title: MCP Gateway config schema v12 (DRAFT, 13.9.0)
description: Draft of the config schema 14.0 will run. 13.x runs schema v11 and refuses version 12. See docs/design/schema-v12.md.

failurePolicy.description: v11 kernel.failurePolicy: per-module override, only for modules whose policy is configurable

lifecycle.description: NEW in v12 (not read by 13.x): bounds for the lifecycle calls

capabilities.description: NEW in v12 (not read by 13.x): per-module capability denials; a module that declares a denied capability fails to activate

features.description: Feature module sections, each named after its module id (camelCase).
